judge_panel.reasoning: The reviewer does not flag or challenge the claim that SAC is described as an on-policy algorithm. The review does not mention off-policy vs. on-policy categorization or critique the haarnoja2018soft citation in any relevant way.
The review does not mention Soft Actor-Critic being on-policy/off-policy, nor does it challenge the claim against Haarnoja et al. No citation-specific contradiction is flagged.
The reviewer does not mention the classification of the SAC algorithm as on-policy vs off-policy, nor do they reference the specific claim or the Haarnoja citation.

The reviewer never mentions the simulation budget arithmetic (5,980 + 1,500 ≠ 7,500) or the specific training/target simulation counts for the OpAmp. No numerical inconsistency related to this injection is flagged.
The review does not discuss the OpAmp training/target simulation budget arithmetic or the 5,980 vs 6,000 figure. No specific numerical inconsistency is identified.
The report contains no mention of simulation budgets, training counts, or the arithmetic inconsistency (5,980 + 1,500 = 7,500).

The reviewer mentions in 3.4 a minor notation note about Q_θ1 and Q_θ2 subscripts/superscripts being misaligned, but does not specifically flag the algebraic error of Q²-y² replacing (Q-y)². This is too vague to count as detection of the mathematical injection.

The reviewer notes only a notation/formatting issue in Section 2.3 ('subscripts/superscripts might be slightly misaligned'), not that the Bellman loss term was mathematically incorrect as Q^2 - y^2 instead of (Q-y)^2.

While the reviewer mentions notation consistency in Section 2.3, they specifically refer to subscripts and superscripts for the Q-functions, not the algebraic error where a squared difference was replaced by a difference of squares.
The reviewer does not flag any mismatch between the prose referencing Table~\ref{tab:rl_circuit_params} and the actual content of evaluation metrics. No cross-reference error is mentioned.

Although the reviewer comments that T.S.E. should be discussed in the main text of Section 5.3, they do not flag any mismatch between the prose claim and the referenced table, nor any incorrect cross-reference to the parameter-count table.

The reviewer discusses Table 3 and Section 5.3 regarding metric definitions and a typo, but they do not identify that the text in 5.3 erroneously references the parameter table instead of the results table.
